description: Read how new conversations are automatically given to team members (operators): the assignment mode (off / round robin / least open), which team receives them, whether only available operators count, the per-operator cap, reassigning a conversation when its operator does not reply in time, rebalancing, and the backup operator. Each setting comes with a plain-words explanation, plus the teams, operators and limits you can use with update_assignment_rules. Read-only. Use get_workload / get_agent_performance for who currently holds which chats, and reassign_conversations to move chats by hand.
name: get_assignment_rules
